title: 12 Best Wine Bars in Casablanca
description: Discover the top 12 wine bars in Casablanca, Morocco. From chic rooftops to cozy bistros, find the perfect spot for Moroccan and international wines, tapas, and unforgettable experiences. Updated for 2026.

places.name: Le Cabestan Ocean View
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A bottle of organic Moroccan wine (e.g., Domaine du Val d'Argan) paired with fresh oysters or a selection of refined tapas.

places.name: La Bodega de Casablanca
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A pitcher of classic Sangria or a bottle of red (e.g., Ksar d'Atlas) with a mix of patatas bravas, gambas al ajillo, and chorizo.

places.name: Bistrot Chic
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A glass of Sancerre or Bordeaux paired with their duck confit or a cheese platter.

places.name: Rick's Café
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A classic Moroccan red wine or a glass of sparkling wine while enjoying the piano player's tunes.

places.name: Lily's
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A crisp white wine from the Loire Valley or a full-bodied Spanish red with their signature appetizers.

places.name: Le Boudoir
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A Moroccan rosé (e.g., Gris de Boulaouane) with a selection of artisanal cheeses and charcuterie.

places.name: Le Relais de Paris (L'Entrecôte)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A glass or bottle of Bordeaux or a robust Cabernet Sauvignon to pair with the entrecôte.

places.name: Le Gatsby
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order An elegant sparkling wine or a high-quality New World red to enjoy with their jazz nights.

places.name: Le Petit Rocher
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A chilled Moroccan white wine (e.g., Fes Blanc) with grilled fish or calamari.

places.name: La Cocina
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Try a flight of different Moroccan wines to pair with their varied tapas selection.

places.name: Rouge
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A glass of international Chardonnay or a bold Cabernet Sauvignon from their well-stocked cellar.

places.name: Vertigo (Four Seasons Hotel Casablanca)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A glass of premium Champagne or a fine vintage red from their exclusive collection.
